issue_context.title: Flo by Moen rarely updates
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Water usage appears to update regularly, but flow rate, pressure and temperature update maybe once a day. I have no data on current system mode or pending system alerts because I don't use those functions at the moment.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.7.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Flo by Moen

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/flo/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

No errors in the log and the logbook is empty for the water flow rate and temperature sensors.
comments:
Hey there @dmulcahey, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`flo`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L167) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

This seems to have been a problem even with the custom component by @rsnodgrass. The data will only update if you are logged into your Moen app or dashboard online.

@rsnodgrass hypothesized that this is due to a heartbeat signal in this post:
https://community.home-assistant.io/t/flo-smart-water-leak-detector/119532/27

> Looks like Flo v2 API may require a heartbeat keep-alive API call periodically for the server side to keep refreshing.
> POST https://api-gw.meetflo.com/api/v2/presence/me 9
>
> Headers:
> authorization: XXXXX
> The web interface posts a heartbeat every 30 seconds.
> Note: Since there is a Flo integration built into Home Assistant now, the custom integration is now not being maintained.

@bachya 's library does not have this call built in, and we'd need to get it there first, and then @dmulcahey would need to create a new `DataUpdateCoordinator` to just ping this endpoint every 30s or so... and then this issue might be solved.

I have tested this locally and it does appear to correct the issue w/ stale data from the API. I have a PR open against the lib: https://github.com/bachya/aioflo/pull/47 and I'll PR the change to HA once it is merged / released.
@dmulcahey I've merged your other PR and released version 2021.11.0 of `aioflo`.

> @dmulcahey I've merged your other PR and released version 2021.11.0 of `aioflo`.

Thanks!
The above linked PR fixes this issue. Sorry it took me so long to resolve this.

review_comments: Does this need to be executed first in order for these other calls to work? `asyncio.gather` makes no guarantee about call order.

So I debated this myself (and initially coded it that way with this new call before the gather)… given that this runs every 30 seconds I don’t think splitting the calls out makes sense. At most the data would be 1 update cycle old… is that worth stacking the calls and making them run serially? I didn’t think so but I’m open to other opinions.
Got it. Let's roll with what you have; we can always adjust later.
